svg.title: Tentaflake
svg.desc: Tentaflake: isolated AI agents, declarative infrastructure. NixOS, gVisor, Rust. Illustration: the original Tentaflake logo, a blue octopus within crystal arms, floats over the glowing core of one dark host base. Tentacle cables run from the core to four separate platforms on that base, each inside a faint box with one agent; no cable joins two agents. Larger tentacles reach around the base from below. A small panel labelled tentaflake.toml sends a cable into the core.
